data.name: Jumadi
data.gender_notes: Jumadi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'jamada', meaning 'to follow'. In Islamic tradition, Jumadi is a name given to those born during the month of Muharram, which is symbolically associated with following the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Jumadi carries the meaning “Follower of the moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jumadi usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes blessings, good luck, and prosperity.
data.etymology: Jumadi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of the moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jumadi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: جمادي
in_arabic.long_meaning: جمادي هو اسم شهر في التقويم الهجري، وهو مشتق من الجمود، ويشير إلى فترة من الجمود وعدم الحركة، وقد ورد ذكر الأشهر الهجرية في القرآن الكريم في سورة التوبة آية 36

in_urdu.name: جمادی
in_urdu.long_meaning: جمادی ہجری تقویم میں ایک مہینہ ہے، جو جمود سے ماخوذ ہے، اور یہ ایک مدت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے جس میں کوئی تبدیلی نہیں ہوتی ہے، اسلامی تقویم کے بارے میں معلومات قرآن مجید میں سورة التوبة آية 36 میں پائی جاتی ہیں

in_hindi.name: जुमादी
in_hindi.long_meaning: जुमादी हिजरी कैलेंडर में एक महीना है, जो जुमूद से लिया गया है, और यह एक ऐसी अवधि को इंगित करता है जिसमें कोई परिवर्तन नहीं होता है, इस्लामी कैलेंडर के बारे में जानकारी कुरआन में सूरा التوبة آية 36 में मिलती है

in_pashto.name: جمادي
in_pashto.long_meaning: جمادي د هجري تقويم يو مياشت دی، چی د جمود څخه مشتق شوی دی، او هغه موده ښيي چی په کې کوم بدلون نه وي، د اسلامي تقويم معلومات په قرآن کريم کې د سورة التوبة آية 36 کې موندل کيږي

data.cultural_impact: The name Jumadi holds cultural significance as it is specifically associated with a month in the Islamic lunar calendar. This naming practice is rooted in the rich cultural tradition of naming a child based on the month of their birth, following the Prophet Muhammad's example. This process is an important aspect of keeping historical and cultural connections alive and instilling a sense of pride in this heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Jumadi carries deep meaning as it underscores the concept of following the path of the Prophet Muhammad, and in turn, the path of Allah. By embracing this name, a child is being reminded of their duty to live their life in accordance with Islamic teachings and to follow the footsteps of the Prophet Muhammad, aiming to lead a virtuous and pious life.
